svg.title: Free-Stuff-Near-You — Mint Tilt $0 logo, v4
svg.desc: The unified tag-and-local-point contour tilts eight degrees as one form, keeping the $0 aligned inside it. The soft mint fill continues uninterrupted to the bottom. Paired with the exact Free-Stuff-Near-You name in deep green. Original, unadopted concept with editable text and transparent surroundings.

text.font-family: Avenir Next, Trebuchet MS, Arial, sans-serif
